title: Implement first-party app authentication for Microsoft Fabric Export
summary: Adds first-party app authentication to the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring export. The credential management, admin client, platform management, setup page and setup wizard are updated, a new environment cleanup subscriber codeunit is added, and tests are extended.
key_points: Adds first-party app authentication for the Fabric export
Updates the credential management and admin client codeunits
Reworks the Fabric Platform Setup page and setup wizard
Adds a new environment cleanup subscriber codeunit
Extends platform tests and the test subscriber
